longest_story.title: In the Clutches of...the Kingpin!
longest_story.first_line: At last!!
longest_story.characters: Betty Brant; Frederick Foswell; J. Jonah Jameson; Kingpin [Wilson Fisk] (villain); Ned Leeds; Harry Osborn; Robbie Robertson; Spider-Man [Peter Parker]; Gwen Stacy; Mary Jane Watson; Shorty (villain); Big Turk (villain); Flint (villain)
longest_story.synopsis: Spider-Man is back and starts interfering with Kingpin's criminal activities. Kingpin recruits shady reporter Foswell and kidnaps J. Jonah Jameson. Spider-Man intervenes, but is exposed to gas which renders him helpless at the Kingpin's feet.

longest_story.title: To Die A Hero!
longest_story.first_line: I would'a thought a guy as strong as Spider-Man would be a heckuva lot heavier!
longest_story.characters: Betty Brant; Frederick Foswell (death); J. Jonah Jameson; Kingpin [Wilson Fisk] (villain); Ned Leeds; Harry Osborn; Robbie Robertson; Spider-Man [Peter Parker]; Gwen Stacy; Flash Thompson; Mary Jane Watson; Flint (villain); Big Turk (villain); Shorty (villain)
longest_story.synopsis: Kingpin tries to drown Spider-Man and Jameson in the basement, but Spider-Man breaks free and confronts Kingpin. Foswell turns on Kingpin and helps Jameson to escape, but at the price of his own life. Meanwhile, Flash Thompson has returned, on leave from the military.

longest_story.title: Enter: Dr. Octopus
longest_story.first_line: Well, it figgers!
longest_story.characters: Dr. Octopus [Otto Octavius] (villain); J. Jonah Jameson; Aunt May; Harry Osborn; Spider-Man [Peter Parker]; Gwen Stacy; Flash Thompson; Professor Miles Warren; Anna Watson; Mary Jane Watson
longest_story.notes: Continued in the next 3 issues.

longest_story.title: The Tentacles and the Trap!
longest_story.first_line: Of course I remember you!
longest_story.characters: Dr. Octopus [Otto Octavius] (villain); J. Jonah Jameson; Aunt May; Harry Osborn; Robbie Robertson; Spider-Man [Peter Parker]; Gwen Stacy; Mary Jane Watson

longest_story.title: Doc Ock Wins!
longest_story.first_line: Heads up, you masked misfits!
longest_story.characters: Dr. Octopus [Otto Octavius] (villain); J. Jonah Jameson; Lieutenant Colonel John Jameson; Ned Leeds; Aunt May; Harry Osborn; Robbie Robertson; Spider-Man [Peter Parker]; Gwen Stacy; Anna Watson; Mary Jane Watson

longest_story.title: Disaster!
longest_story.first_line: Faster, you fool!
longest_story.characters: Betty Brant; Dr. Octopus [Otto Octavius] (villain); J. Jonah Jameson; John Jameson; Aunt May; Harry Osborn; Robbie Robertson; Spider-Man [Peter Parker]; Captain George Stacy (First appearance); Gwen Stacy; Anna Watson; Mary Jane Watson
longest_story.synopsis: Spider-Man, with his memory compromised, assists Doctor Octopus in his schemes.

longest_story.title: The Coming of Ka-Zar!
longest_story.first_line: Although Spidey finally defeated Doc Ock last issue--the web-spinner lost his memory in the process!
longest_story.characters: J. Jonah Jameson; John Jameson; Ka-Zar [Kevin Plunder] (guest); Aunt May; Harry Osborn; Spider-Man [Peter Parker]; Captain George Stacy; Gwen Stacy; Anna Watson; Zabu
longest_story.synopsis: Spider-Man is still dealing with the loss of his memory; meanwhile, J. Jonah Jameson enlists the aid of Ka-Zar to capture Spider-Man.

longest_story.title: To Kill a Spider-Man!
longest_story.pencils: John Romita (credited as Johnny Romita) (layouts); Don Heck (credited as Donny Heck) (pencils)
longest_story.first_line: Anyone else might have thought Spidey was dead when Ka-Zar fished him out of the lake last ish...
longest_story.characters: Betty Brant; J. Jonah Jameson (villain); John Jameson; Ka-Zar [Kevin Plunder] (supporting); Ned Leeds; Aunt May; Harry Osborn; Robbie Robertson; Professor Smythe (antagonist); Spider-Man [Peter Parker]; Spider-Slayer (villain); Captain George Stacy; Gwen Stacy; Zabu (supporting)

longest_story.title: The Brand of the Brainwasher!
longest_story.pencils: John Romita (credited as Johnny Romita) (layouts); Don Heck (credited) (pencils)
longest_story.first_line: I refilled my web cartridges just in time!
longest_story.characters: Kingpin [Wilson Fisk] (antagonist) (as Brainwasher); Aunt May; Harry Osborn; Spider-Man [Peter Parker]; Captain George Stacy; Gwen Stacy; Mary Jane Watson

longest_story.title: O, Bitter Victory!
longest_story.pencils: John Romita (credited as Johnny Romita) (layouts); Don Heck (credited as Donnie Heck) (pencils)
longest_story.first_line: I'm glad you've learned the brainwasher's true identity---
longest_story.characters: J. Jonah Jameson; Kingpin [Wilson Fisk] (villain); Aunt May; Harry Osborn; Spider-Man [Peter Parker]; Captain George Stacy; Gwen Stacy; Anna Watson; Mary Jane Watson; Doctor Winkler

longest_story.title: What a Tangled Web We Weave..!
longest_story.first_line: Will Gwen and her father ever forgive me... for what I've done to them?
longest_story.characters: J. Jonah Jameson; Kingpin [Wilson Fisk]; Aunt May; Harry Osborn; Norman Osborn; Spider-Man [Peter Parker]; Captain George Stacy; Gwen Stacy; Mary Jane Watson; Doctor Winkler

longest_story.title: Make Way For---Medusa!
longest_story.first_line: Something just sliced thru my webbing!
longest_story.characters: J. Jonah Jameson; Medusa [Medusalith Amaquelin Boltagon]; Harry Osborn; Norman Osborn; Spider-Man [Peter Parker]; Captain George Stacy; Gwen Stacy; Mary Jane Watson; Montgomery G. Bliss; Wilberforce
longest_story.synopsis: Medusa travels to New York City to gauge the reaction of the common person to the presence of an Inhuman.
longest_story.notes: The Spectacular Spider-Man Magazine #1 appears about this time.

longest_story.title: Wings in the Night!
longest_story.first_line: Vulture! The dictionary says: "...a bird, person, or creature that strikes ruthlessly and ravenously..."
longest_story.characters: Betty Brant; J. Jonah Jameson; Kraven the Hunter [Sergei Kravinoff] (flashback); Harry Osborn; Norman Osborn; Spider-Man [Peter Parker]; Captain George Stacy; Gwen Stacy; Vulture [Blackie Drago] (villain); Vulture [Adrian Toomes] (villain); Dr. Miles Warren
longest_story.notes: Continued in the next issue.

longest_story.title: The Vulture's Prey
longest_story.pencils: John Romita (credited) (layouts); Don Heck (credited as Donnie Heck) (pencils)
longest_story.first_line: The Vulture still lives!!
longest_story.characters: Betty Brant; J. Jonah Jameson; Ned Leeds; Aunt May; Robbie Robertson; Spider-Man [Peter Parker]; Captain George Stacy; Gwen Stacy; Vulture [Adrian Toomes] (villain); Anna Watson; Mary Jane Watson

longest_story.title: The Impossible Escape!
longest_story.first_line: Last ish, we saw Spidey injured during his epic battle with the murderous Vulture!
longest_story.characters: J. Jonah Jameson; Aunt May; Harry Osborn; Norman Osborn; Robbie Robertson; Spider-Man [Peter Parker]; Captain George Stacy; Gwen Stacy; Mary Jane Watson
longest_story.notes:
Severin colors confirmed on this site:

http://www.hakes.com/item.asp?Auction=210&ItemNo=127471

longest_story.title: The Madness of Mysterio!
longest_story.pencils: John Romita (credited as Johnny Romita) (layouts); Don Heck (credited) (pencils)
longest_story.first_line: The stage is set--the plan is completed--the time has come!
longest_story.characters: Betty Brant; Green Goblin [Norman Osborn]; J. Jonah Jameson; Ned Leeds; Aunt May; Mysterio [Quentin Beck] (villain); Harry Osborn; Robbie Robertson; Spider-Man [Peter Parker]; Captain George Stacy; Gwen Stacy; Anna Watson
longest_story.notes: Continued in the next issue.

longest_story.title: To Squash a Spider!
longest_story.first_line: Trapped by the madly murderous Mysterio, our hapless web-spinner suddenly regains consciousness, only to find that he has become--six inches tall!
longest_story.characters: Betty Brant; Dr. Nicholas Bromwell; J. Jonah Jameson; Ned Leeds; Aunt May; Mysterio [Quentin Beck] (villain); Randy Robertson (First appearance); Robbie Robertson; Spider-Man [Peter Parker]; Captain George Stacy; Gwen Stacy; Anna Watson

longest_story.title: Crisis on the Campus!
longest_story.pencils: John Romita (credited as Johnny Romita) (layouts); Jim Mooney (credited) (pencils)
longest_story.first_line: So that's what the newly-discovered petrified clay tablet looks like!
longest_story.characters: Spider-Man [Peter Parker]; Kingpin (villain); Gwen Stacy; J. Jonah Jameson; Joe Robertson; Anna Watson; Aunt May Parker; Crusher; Louis Wilson (introduction); Randy Robertson; Martha Robertson (introduction, in a photograph only); Josh Kittling (introduction)
longest_story.notes: Continued in the next 2 issues.

longest_story.title: Mission: Crush the Kingpin!
longest_story.first_line: The Kingpin's hiding somewhere in this area!
longest_story.characters: Spider-Man [Peter Parker]; Kingpin; Robbie Robertson; Randy Robertson; J. Jonah Jameson; Gwen Stacy; Mr. Stacy (Gwen's father)
longest_story.synopsis: Spider-Man goes heads-up with the strength of the Kingpin, who is knocked out when his own cane-gun backfires. The police arrest the Kingpin for theft of the priceless tablet, but he claims that his ally Spider-Man has spirited it away. Meanwhile, Spider-Man manages to open the vault and retrieve the tablet, but when he tries to return it the police open fire on him.

longest_story.title: Spider-Man Wanted!
longest_story.first_line: I've got to get out of here!
longest_story.characters: Spider-Man [Peter Parker]; Kingpin; J. Jonah Jameson; Gwen Stacy; Captain Stacy; Robbie Robertson; Randy Robertson; Josh; Dean Corliss; Ned Leeds
longest_story.synopsis: Still on the lam, Spider-Man hides the tablet in Peter's closet. The Kingpin breaks out of jail vowing to get Spider-Man and the tablet. Spider-Man obliges him and the two battle. In the middle of the battle, Jonah driven by Ned Leeds appears and calls for the police. A mysterious car with a woman driver appears and the Kingpin gets away, unsatisfied. Faced with yet another rant from Jameson, Spider-Man turns and starts to rant right back causing Jonah to have an apparently fatal heart attack. Is Spider-Man a murderer!?

longest_story.title: The Speedster and the Spider!
longest_story.pencils: John Romita (credited as Johnny Romita) (layouts); Jim Mooney (credited) (pencils)
longest_story.first_line: Last ish, we saw our tormented web-slinger finally lose his temper as he angrily threatened a nearly hysterical J. Jonah Jameson!
longest_story.characters: Betty Brant; J. Jonah Jameson; John Jameson; Edwin Jarvis; Kingpin [Wilson Fisk] (flashback) (cameo); Ned Leeds; Harry Osborn; Quicksilver [Pietro Maximoff]; Joseph Robertson; Martha Robertson; Randy Robertson; Scarlet Witch [Wanda Maximoff] (flashback) (cameo); Spider-Man [Peter Parker]; George Stacy; Toad [Mortimer Toynbee] (flashback) (cameo)
longest_story.synopsis: With Jonah down for the count, Robbie publishes Peter's pictures in the Bugle showing Kingpin, and not Spider-Man, to be the real crook in the case of the golden tablet. Trying to redeem himself after his recent career with Magneto, Quicksilver decides to bring in the menace known as Spider-Man but discovers he isn't the villain the Bugle has painted him to be.

longest_story.title: Rocked by... the Shocker!
longest_story.pencils: John Buscema (credited) (layouts); John Romita (credited as Johnny Romita) (pencils)
longest_story.first_line: Forgive my sudden entrance, Stacy...
longest_story.characters: Spider-Man [Peter Parker]; Shocker [Herman Schultz]; Gwen Stacy; George Stacy; Aunt May; Lizard [Curt Connors]; J. Jonah Jameson; Flash Thompson

longest_story.title: The Web Closes!
longest_story.script: John Buscema (credited) (plot); John Romita (credited) (plot); Stan Lee (credited) (script)
longest_story.first_line: It's my fault that Captain Stacy was injured by the Shocker!
longest_story.characters: Spider-Man [Peter Parker]; Man-Mountain Marko; the Maggia; Caesar Cicero; Silvermane; George Stacy; Gwen Stacy; Randy Robertson; Robbie Robertson; J. Jonah Jameson; Wilson; Curt Connors
longest_story.notes: Continued in the next 2 issues.

longest_story.title: If This Be Bedlam!
longest_story.script: John Romita (credited as Johnny Romita) (plot); Stan Lee (credited) (script)
longest_story.pencils: John Romita (credited as Johnny Romita) (layouts); Jim Mooney (credited) (pencils)
longest_story.first_line: You better do what Silvermane wants, see?
longest_story.characters: Spider-Man [Peter Parker]; Lizard [Dr. Connors]; Martha Connors; Billy Connors; Harry Osborn; Gwen Stacy; Maggia (villain); Silvermane (villain); Caeser Cicero (villain); Man-Mountain Marko (villain)
longest_story.synopsis: Silvermane believes that the petrified tablet contains the secret of the Fountain of Youth. He forces Dr. Connor to interpret the tablet and make the serum described therein. Silvermane drinks the untested serum - and it works!

longest_story.title: Death without Warning!
longest_story.first_line: I've got to find Doc Connors!
longest_story.characters: Spider-Man [Peter Parker]; Lizard [Dr. Connors]; Man-Mountain Marko; Silvermane (death); Caeser Cicero; Martha Connors; Billy Connors
longest_story.synopsis: Spider-Man, aware that Dr. Connors and his family are in danger from the Maggia, searches for them. The once-elderly Silvermane tries to convince Marko and Cicero that he is in fact a younger version of himself while Dr. Connors escapes and Spider-Man arrives. In the ensuing free-for-all Connors transforms into the Lizard and Silvermane just keeps getting younger.
longest_story.notes: The Lizard is also in the next two issues.

longest_story.title: The Lizard Lives!
longest_story.first_line: Nothing can stop the Lizard!
longest_story.characters: Spider-Man [Peter Parker]; Lizard [Curt Connors] (villain); Billy Connors; Martha Connors; Aunt May Parker; Harry Osborn; Gwen Stacy; Robbie Robertson; Captain George Stacy; Human Torch [Johnny Storm]
longest_story.synopsis: The Lizard is at large in New York and Captain Stacy wants to talk to Peter about Spider-Man's secret identity.

longest_story.title: In the Blaze of Battle!
longest_story.first_line: As we saw last ish, just as Spidey was just about to trap the deadly Lizard, he was interrupted by the Human Torch...
longest_story.characters: Spider-Man [Peter Parker]; Lizard [Doctor Curt Connors] (villain); Human Torch [Johnny Storm]; Billy Connors; Martha Connors
longest_story.synopsis: The Human Torch complicates Spider-Man's plan to catch the Lizard without hurting him.

longest_story.title: The Night of the Prowler!
longest_story.first_line: The city is quiet tonight!
longest_story.characters: Spider-Man [Peter Parker]; Gwen Stacy; Flash Thompson; J. Jonah Jameson; Robbie Robertson; Prowler [Hobie Brown] (introduction, origin)
longest_story.synopsis: Peter tries to see Gwen only to find that she is (apparently) on a date with Flash. Hobie approaches his boss with ideas for new safety devices for his job as window-washer, only to be rebuffed. He implements them in private, adds a cloak and a mask, and thus creates The Prowler. Hobie plans to rob a newspaper as the Prowler then return the money as Hobie, making himself a hero. Naturally Peter (as Peter) discovers the Prowler in the act and J. Jonah discovers Peter in front of an empty safe.
longest_story.notes:
Continued in the next issue.

A note on the splash page explains: "Thanks to John Romita, Jr. for suggesting the Prowler."

longest_story.title: To Prowl No More!
longest_story.first_line: Someone in a costume... robbing Jonah Jameson in his office!
longest_story.characters: Spider-Man [Peter Parker]; The Prowler [Hobie Brown]; J. Jonah Jameson; Robbie Robertson; Gwen Stacy; Mindy (Hobie's girlfriend, reference only)
longest_story.synopsis: Spider-Man and the Prowler fight. The Prowler gets away using a gas bomb, then plans another robbery to make himself (Hobie) a hero when the loot is recovered. Peter anticipates the move and gets there during the robbery. This time the Prowler's gas has no effect and Peter unmasks him to find a well-intentioned kid like himself. Spider-Man lets him go.

longest_story.title: On the Trail of... the Chameleon!
longest_story.first_line: I can't keep brooding about Gwen ditching me for Flash Thompson!
longest_story.characters: Chameleon [Dmitri Smerdyakov] (antagonist); J. Jonah Jameson; Harry Osborn; Robbie Robertson; Spider-Man [Peter Parker]; Captain George Stacy; Gwen Stacy; Flash Thompson
longest_story.synopsis: Harry brings Flash to Peter's apartment and forces them to work out the confusion about Gwen. Peter and Gwen reunite and attend a gala where paintings are stolen under the nose of Captain Stacy - it is the work of the Chameleon. Spider-Man sets a trap for the Chameleon but fails to unmask him until he sees... Peter Parker!

longest_story.title: The Coming of the Kangaroo!
longest_story.first_line: Don't like swinging this close to the crowds--but, if I move fast enough, they won't be able to stop me!
longest_story.characters: J. Jonah Jameson; Kangaroo [Frank Oliver] (origin) (introduction); Aunt May Parker; Spider-Man [Peter Parker]
longest_story.synopsis: Aunt May decides Peter is sick and puts him to bed. The Kangaroo escapes Feds who seek to deport him, then steals what he thinks is money but is actually a vial of deadly bacteria. Peter sneaks out to catch the Kangaroo and get the vial back. He succeeds, but Aunt May collapses when she finds the web dummy Peter left in his bed. Now Peter feels more guilt than ever.

longest_story.title: And Then Came Electro!
longest_story.pencils: John Romita (credited) (layouts); Jim Mooney (credited) (pencils); Marie Severin (see notes)
longest_story.first_line: Weary and dejected, a brooding youth sits motionless in the silence of his room...
longest_story.characters: Spider-Man [Peter Parker]; Mary Jane Watson; Anna Watson (Mary Jane’s aunt); J. Jonah Jameson; Electro [Max Dillon] (origin recap); Captain George Stacy; Flash Thompson; Harry Osborn; Robbie Robertson; Marvin (talk show host)
longest_story.synopsis: Peter decides that it would be good for his public image to go on a TV talk show. Unfortunately he chooses a network where Max Dillon [Electro] works. In collusion with Jameson, Electro attacks Spider-Man live on stage. Spider-Man defeats him, but it is a Pyrrhic victory; Peter is as beat up as Max.
longest_story.notes:
The "Midnight Talk Show" host, Marvin, is modeled after Merv Griffin (with his co-host modeled after Arthur Treacher). Marie Severin redrew their faces (pencils and inks) on pages 14 and 15.

There is a great two-panel scene where the web-head - in Peter-civvies with a bag on his head - swings into a laundromat to wash his costume in preparation for the show.

longest_story.title: The Schemer!
longest_story.inks: Mike Esposito (credited as Mickey Demeo); Tony Mortellaro (backgrounds)
longest_story.first_line: Ever since Spider-Man drove the Kingpin into hiding last year, no one has been powerful enough to take his place as King of Crime... until now!
longest_story.characters: Betty Brant; Vanessa Fisk; J. Jonah Jameson; Kingpin [Wilson Fisk]; Harry Osborn; Robbie Robertson; Schemer [Richard Fisk] (behind mask, Richard Fisk also in photo); Spider-Man [Peter Parker]; Captain George Stacy; Gwen Stacy; Flash Thompson; Doctor Bromwell
longest_story.synopsis: The Schemer tries to become the new King of Crime in New York, and starts a war with the Kingpin. Flash Thompson goes to war in Vietnam and Gwen Stacy is injured in a traffic accident.
longest_story.notes: Continued in the next 2 issues. As revealed when reprinted in Marvel Tales # 64, Tony Mortellaro assisted Esposito on backgrounds.

longest_story.title: The Kingpin Strikes Back!
longest_story.first_line: It's a good thing I didn't capture the Schemer when last we fought... there wasn't any reward for him then!
longest_story.characters: Spider-Man [Peter Parker]; Schemer; Gwen Stacy; Captain George Stacy; Kingpin; Vanessa Fisk
longest_story.synopsis: Peter could use the $5,000 reward, so Spider-Man sets out to capture The Schemer. He eventually finds him in his fancy car but keeps falling off it. Schemer arrives at the Kingpin's mansion and confronts him; Vanessa intervenes. Spider-Man has followed Schemer, breaks in, and has a brief tiff with Kingpin before they both realize that both Schemer and Vanessa have vanished.

longest_story.title: The Secret of the Schemer!
longest_story.pencils: John Romita (credited as J. Romita) (layouts); John Buscema (credited as J. Buscema) (pencils)
longest_story.first_line: Last issue, we saw the mysterious Schemer face-to-face with the Kingpin--and the Kingpin's wife...
longest_story.characters: Spider-Man [Peter Parker]; Vanessa Fisk; Captain Stacy; Gwen Stacy; Kingpin (villain); Schemer [Richard Fisk; identity revealed] (villain)
longest_story.synopsis: Peter pulls a double switch to keep Captain Stacy and Gwendy from identifying him as Spider-Man. Spider-Man tracks down the Schemer but they both fall into the Kingpin's trap. The ensuing battle comes to an abrupt end when the Schemer is revealed to be Richard Fisk, the Kingpin's long lost son.

longest_story.title: Beware... the Black Widow!
longest_story.first_line: Can't wait to get home!
longest_story.characters: Black Widow [Natasha Romanoff]; Crimson Dynamo [Boris Turgenev] (cameo flashback); Nick Fury (flashback); Hawkeye [Clint Barton] (flashback); Iron Man [Tony Stark] (cameo flashback); J. Jonah Jameson; Nikita Khruschev (flashback); Harry Osborn; Aunt May Parker; Red Guardian [Alexi Shostakov] (death in flashback ?); Spider-Man [Peter Parker]; Captain George Stacy; Gwen Stacy; Anna Watson
longest_story.synopsis: Natasha Romanova returns to New York with a new costume and decides to test herself by fighting Spider-Man, who defeats her even though he is seriously ill.
longest_story.notes: First Modern Look Black Widow. Don Heck was originally credited with layouts on pages 1-3 but Nick Caputo sees no sign of his input on those pages.

longest_story.title: Unmasked at Last!
longest_story.first_line: As we saw last issue, Spider-Man has been slowly growing weaker!
longest_story.characters: Spider-Man [Peter Parker]; Gwen Stacy; Mary Jane Watson; Harry Osborn; Captain George Stacy; Randy Robertson; Josh (Randy's friend); The Prowler [Hobie Brown]

longest_story.title: The Arms of Doctor Octopus!
longest_story.first_line: Let's visit New York's famous Museum of Natural Science, where its most sensational exhibit is now on display...
longest_story.characters: Spider-Man [Peter Parker]; Gwen Stacy; J. Jonah Jameson; John Jameson; Robbie Robertson; Betty Brant; Captain George Stacy; Doctor Octopus (villain)
longest_story.synopsis: From his prison cell, Doctor Octopus calls to his mechanical arms and even Spider-Man can't stop the inevitable reunion. Doctor Octopus hijacks a plane and holds an Asian general hostage for $10,000,000 but Spider-Man foils his plans.
longest_story.notes: Continued in the next 2 issues.

longest_story.title: Doc Ock Lives!
longest_story.first_line: It's still hard to believe that Dr. Octopus is really dead--but I saw the plane crash with my own eyes!
longest_story.characters: Spider-Man [Peter Parker]; Randy Robertson; J. Jonah Jameson; Robbie Robertson; Dr. Octopus [Otto Octavius] (villain)
longest_story.synopsis: Doctor Octopus versus Spider-Man.
longest_story.notes: Gil Kane takes over the artwork.

longest_story.title: And Death Shall Come!
longest_story.first_line: Last issue we saw the murderous Dr. Octopus hurl our hero from a rooftop--to seemingly certain death below!
longest_story.characters: Doctor Octopus [Otto Octavius] (villain); Harry Osborn (cameo); Spider-Man [Peter Parker]; Captain George Stacy (death); Gwen Stacy

longest_story.title: To Smash a Spider!
longest_story.first_line: ... and so we return George Stacy to the earth which is mother of us all.
longest_story.characters: Spider-Man [Peter Parker]; J. Jonah Jameson; Mary Jane Watson; Harry Osborn; Aunt May Parker; Gwen Stacy; Robbie Robertson; Bullit

longest_story.title: When Iceman Attacks
longest_story.first_line: Gwen--and Bullit--in Peter Parker's apartment!
longest_story.characters: Sam Bullit (villain) (also in flashback); Iceman [Bobby Drake]; J. Jonah Jameson; Robbie Robertson; Spider-Man [Peter Parker] (also in flashback); Gwen Stacy (also in flashback); Carter; Charlie
longest_story.synopsis: Thinking Spider-Man is causing harm to Gwen, Iceman intervenes and tries to defeat Spider-Man. Later, once misunderstandings are resolved, the two team up to take down a crooked politician.

longest_story.title: The Lady and -- the Prowler!
longest_story.first_line: Capt. George Stacy, the father of the girl our hero loves, is dead--and the world mistakenly blames Spider-Man!
longest_story.characters: Spider-Man [Peter Parker]; the Prowler; Gwen Stacy; Arthur Stacy; Captain George Stacy (flashback); Harry Osborn (flashback); Mary Jane Watson (flashback); Mindy Brown

longest_story.title: On Wings of Death!
longest_story.first_line: I still can't believe it, but it's true.
longest_story.characters: Spider-Man [Peter Parker]; the Beetle [Abner Jenkins]; Gwen Stacy (flashback)

longest_story.title: Trap for a Terrorist!
longest_story.first_line: Fasten your safety belt, Spidey-fan!
longest_story.characters: Spider-Man [Peter Parker]; Robbie Robertson; J. Jonah Jameson; Mary Jane Watson; Aunt May Parker; Anna May Watson; Harry Osborn; Arthur Stacy; Gwen Stacy; Herbert Knowles; Inspector Hargraves; Captain George Stacy (cameo flashback)
longest_story.synopsis: Peter heads for England looking for Gwen but is forced to fight terrorists as Spider-Man. Realizing that Peter Parker can't show up with Spider-Man already swinging around, Peter heads home, leaving Gwen in mourning for her father.
longest_story.notes: Story pages are numbered 1-20, but pages 12 and 13 are half-story and half-ads.

longest_story.title: --And Now, the Goblin!
longest_story.first_line: Last ish, we saw Peter Parker in London, where he had gone to find the girl he loves.
longest_story.characters: Spider-Man [Peter Parker]; Betty Brant; Robbie Robertson; Harry Osborn; Aunt May Parker; Anna May Watson; Mary Jane Watson; Green Goblin [Norman Osborn] (villain); Gwen Stacy (cameo flashback)
longest_story.synopsis: Peter returns from England and winds up getting a job with Norman Osborn. Unfortunately, Norman is shocked into becoming the Green Goblin again and sets his sights on Spider-Man.
longest_story.notes:
Continued in the next 2 issues.

Drug references in the story meant that it could not be approved by the Comics Code.

longest_story.title: In the Grip of the Goblin!
longest_story.inks: Frank Giacoia (credited); John Romita (pages 7, 15, 16, 18 and 19); Tony Mortellaro ? (backgrounds)
longest_story.first_line: It's happening again!
longest_story.characters: Spider-Man [also appears as Peter Parker]; Harry Osborn; Mary Jane Watson; Green Goblin [Norman Osborn] (villain); Gwen Stacy (cameo flashback)
longest_story.synopsis: Spider-Man battles the Goblin while Harry starts popping pills to deal with the brush-off Mary Jane has given him.
longest_story.notes:
Story continues in the following issue.

Drug references in the story meant that it could not be approved by the Comics Code.

Backgrounds likely inked by Tony Mortellaro, as he was the background inker on ASM #98 (a billboard seen on the splash page of #98 reads "BACK BY MOR").

John Romita credited as "artist emeritus"

longest_story.title: The Goblin's Last Gasp!
longest_story.first_line: Just as Peter Parker is about to summon the doctor, to aid his sick friend, Harry Osborn--disaster strikes--
longest_story.characters: Spider-Man [also appears as Peter Parker]; Gwen Stacy; J. Jonah Jameson; Robbie Robertson; Harry Osborn; Green Goblin [Norman Osborn] (villain)
longest_story.synopsis: Spider-Man confronts the drug dealer who sold Harry the pills that put him in the hospital. Spider-Man and Green Goblin wage a pitched battle until Spider-Man confronts Norman with his sick son. Gwen returns from London.
longest_story.notes:
Drug references in the story meant that it could not be approved by the Comics Code.

Though not officially credited, a billboard seen on the splash page reads "BACK BY MOR", indicating Tony Mortellaro inked the backgrounds.

longest_story.title: A Day in the Life Of --
longest_story.first_line: This one you don't dare miss!
longest_story.characters: Spider-Man [Peter Parker]; Gwen Stacy; Robbie Robertson; J. Jonah Jameson; Johnny Carson; Ed McMahon; Turpo (villain); Prisoners (villain)
longest_story.synopsis: Peter gets an assignment to snap some pictures of a prison riot and swings in as Spider-Man to get the inside scoop. Once the situation is resolved, Spider-Man appears on the Tonight Show and gives a speech on the rights of prisoners.
longest_story.notes:
Spider-Man appears on the Tonight Show, including caricatures of Johnny Carson and Ed McMahon, although the show and its host are unnamed.   

Tony Mortellaro credited by Bruno Andreachhi (http://errors.comics.org/show_bug.cgi?id=4606)

longest_story.title: The Spider or the Man?
longest_story.inks: Frank Giacoia (credited as F. Giacoia); Tony Mortellaro (backgrounds, signed)
longest_story.first_line: I've been combing the city for hours
longest_story.characters: Spider-Man [Peter Parker]; DREAM CHARACTERS: Aunt May Parker; J. Jonah Jameson; Betty Brant; Ned Leeds; Gwen Stacy; Captain George Stacy; Vulture [Adrian Toomes]; Lizard [Curt Connors]; Green Goblin [Norman Osborn]; Dr. Octopus [Otto Octavius]; Kingpin [Wilson Fisk]
longest_story.synopsis: Peter Parker concocts a potion to take away his powers forever. He passes out and wakes up with 6 arms.
longest_story.notes: Scripter credit from José Luis Roger (May 3, 2004). Script originally credited to: Archie Goodwin.
